fleet_design.name: ESV_MetalolizingFactory
fleet_design.description: A higher number of Combat Engineers that can go anywhere you please, enemy planets or otherwise -- plus a Mobile Factory that launches small drones metabolizing enemies!

fleet_design.name: ESV_RescueBeaconFactory
fleet_design.description: A smaller number of Combat Engineers that can go anywhere you please, enemy planets or otherwise -- plus a Mobile Factory that produces rescue beacons to save ships from destruction!

fleet_design.name: ESV_TranslocatorFactory
fleet_design.description: A decent number of Combat Engineers that can go anywhere you please, enemy planets or otherwise -- plus a Mobile Factory that pushes and paralyzes lighter enemies!

fleet_design.name: ESV_BackdoorFactory
fleet_design.description: A decent number of Combat Engineers that can go anywhere you please, enemy planets or otherwise -- plus a Mobile Factory that is cloaked and can launch tractor drones to push enemies away.

fleet_design.description: A decent number of Combat Engineers that can go anywhere you please, enemy planets or otherwise -- plus a Mobile Factory that is cloaked and can launch tractor drones to push enemies away.
